name: v0.3.28 — 37 retailers on Connections · green add buttons · left-aligned content
releaseNotes:
• Connections retailer catalog expanded from 12 to 37 major US retailers across grocery (Aldi, Publix, H-E-B, Wegmans, Stop & Shop, Giant, Sprouts), wholesale (BJ's), drugstore (CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid), department (Macy's, Kohl's, Nordstrom, TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Ross), home (Lowe's, Wayfair, IKEA), electronics/office (Apple, Staples, Office Depot), dollar stores (Dollar Tree, Dollar General), online marketplaces (eBay, Etsy), food delivery (DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Starbucks), and gas (Shell, Chevron).
• Connections content left-aligned to the sidebar instead of centered (was a big dead zone on wide screens).
• Per-retailer add buttons switched from violet to emerald GuacGreen — back on brand.
